verdict.rationale: LibreChat has a documented User Memory feature, but the evidence is only a page title. It is a self-hosted web app (Docker, npm or Helm), so the memory would live on infrastructure the user controls rather than a vendor cloud. Missing for 10: evidence that users can inspect, edit, or delete remembered items; evidence the memory store uses an open, user-readable format; any detail on where memory is persisted; independent or hands-on corroboration.
